content.value: A shunt generator delivers 195 A at terminal voltage of 250 V. The armature, and shunt field resistances are 0.02 Ω and 50 Ω respectively. The iron and friction losses are equal to 950 W. Find i) e.m.f generated ii) Cu losses iii) Output of the prime mover iv) Commercial, mechanical and electrical efficiencies.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
